name: RSI Divergence Strategy
author: faytterro

instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): rsilen=input.int(14, title="rsi length"); rsisrc=input(close, title="source"); len=input.int(14, title="RSI Divergence length", maxval=500); tpb = input.float(25, title="take profit", group = "buy", step = 0.5); sb = input.float(5, title="stop", group = "buy", step = 0.5); tsb = input.float(0.25, title="trailing stop", group = "buy", step = 0.5); tps = input.float(25, title="take profit", group = "sell", step = 0.5); ss =input.float(5, title="stop", group = "sell", step = 0.5); tss = input.float(0.25, title="trailing stop", group = "sell", step = 0.5); zoom=input.int(0, title="zoom", maxval=27, minval=-27) | Indicator calls: ta.rsi(rsisrc,rsilen); ta.lowest(low,200); ta.highest(ttk[1],len/2); ta.lowest(ttk[1],len/2)
entry_long: Source rule: cg with all conditions true ta.highest(ttk[1],len/2) is below 1
entry_short: Source rule: cr with all conditions true ta.lowest(ttk[1],len/2) exceeds -1
exit: Source rule: (longCondition); order: strategy.exit("exit long", "Long", limit = close*(100+tpb)/100 , stop =close*(100-sb)/100 , trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tsb); Source rule: (shortCondition); order: strategy.exit("exit short", "Short", limit = close*(100-tps)/100, stop = close*(100+ss)/100, trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tss)
stop_loss: strategy.exit("exit long", "Long", limit = close*(100+tpb)/100 , stop =close*(100-sb)/100 , trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tsb); strategy.exit("exit short", "Short", limit = close*(100-tps)/100, stop = close*(100+ss)/100, trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tss)
take_profit: strategy.exit("exit long", "Long", limit = close*(100+tpb)/100 , stop =close*(100-sb)/100 , trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tsb); strategy.exit("exit short", "Short", limit = close*(100-tps)/100, stop = close*(100+ss)/100, trail_price = close , trail_offset = close*tss)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
